source_title: Score a $150 discount the Apple Watch Ultra 3
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Amazon just knocked $150 off the Apple Watch Ultra 3, dropping it from its $799 recommended retail price to $649. That’s a 19% discount relative to the RRP, and it’s a strong chance to grab Apple’s top adventure watch for a lot less.
The Apple Watch Ultra 3 is built for people who want more than a basic smartwatch. This version pairs a 49mm GPS + Cellular setup with a rugged natural titanium case and a Light Blue Alpine Loop in size L. It’s made for running, hiking, and multisport training, with advanced workout metrics, heart-rate zones, training tools, customizable workouts, and dual-frequency GPS to help track your routes more accurately.
Durability is a big part of the package too. Apple describes it as especially tough, with a sapphire crystal display, titanium construction, and an Action button that gives you quick access to key functions. Battery life is rated for multiday use, with up to about 42 hours in typical use, which makes it a better fit for long workouts and outdoor trips than many standard smartwatches.
One of the standout features is its satellite support, including Emergency SOS and other communication and safety tools for times when you’re away from cellular coverage. On top of that, it handles health tracking with sleep, heart-rate, and broader wellness monitoring. It also has a 4.7-star Amazon rating, which adds even more confidence to this deal.
At $649 on Amazon, this is a notable discount on a premium Apple wearable that’s built for outdoor use and serious training.
